motive.zhHans: 动机显然是他的妻子与 Togawa 之间的外遇，这伤了他的个人自尊。为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。
motive.en: The motive was obviously the affair between his wife and Togawa, which had injured his personal pride. In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found.

method.zhHans: 为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。决定性的证据是 Togawa 的眼镜，Tengan 用 Kazuko 的血浸透了它，然后把它塞进 Togawa 的包里。在陈述事实之前，Conan 另外在木偶上藏了两只假手套，使 Tengan 不由自主地脱口供认，从而彻底粉碎了他的不在场证明。
method.en: In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found. The decisive pieces of evidence are Togawa's glasses Tengan had drenched with Kazuko's blood and then planted inside Togawa's bag. Before his presentation of the facts, Conan additionally hid two fake gloves on the puppet, making Tengan burst out with an involuntary confession and thus completely shattering his alibi.

evidence.zhHans: 为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。决定性的证据是 Togawa 的眼镜，Tengan 用 Kazuko 的血浸透了它，然后把它塞进 Togawa 的包里。在此过程中，眼镜沾上了 Tengan 手套的一些纤维，鉴识人员发现它们粘在眼镜框上。但 Conan 推断出了它们的藏匿之处，经检验，在木偶上发现了带有 Kazuko 的血和 Tengan 的汗液的手套纤维痕迹。
evidence.en: In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found. The decisive pieces of evidence are Togawa's glasses Tengan had drenched with Kazuko's blood and then planted inside Togawa's bag. In the process, the glasses had caught some fibers from Tengan's gloves, which were found clinging to the glasses' frame by the forensics. But Conan has deduced their hiding place, and by having it examined, traces of the gloves' fibers with Kazuko's blood and Tengan's sweat were found on the puppet.

resolution.zhHans: 真正的犯人是 Riichi Tengan。动机显然是他的妻子与 Togawa 之间的外遇，这伤了他的个人自尊。为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。此外，开场时表演的突然改变，是为了进一步“证实”他在雇佣 Kogoro 的时候就已经被逼疯了。这一切都是为了先让自己蒙受嫌疑，然后再通过把罪名嫁祸给自己的徒弟、并以“被诱导的”分裂人格为由主张无罪，来使自己脱罪。
resolution.en: The real culprit is Riichi Tengan. The motive was obviously the affair between his wife and Togawa, which had injured his personal pride. In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found. In addition, the sudden change of the act in the opening scene was meant to further "confirm" that he was already driven into insanity by the time he hired Kogoro. This was all meant to initially cast suspicion on himself, only to have him cleared by both pinning the blame on his apprentice and claiming innocence by reason of his "induced" split personality.
